Usage: node gate.mjs <report.json> [...report.json] --review <REVIEW.json> [--json]

Combines one or more checker report files (JSON output from
"considered contract --json" and/or "considered lint --json") with an
independent review file into the real ship gate. Both a report and
--review are required.

Example: node gate.mjs contract.json lint.json --review REVIEW.json
